subject: whimper or WOOSH!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I think I figured out the main reason for me that Paradise doesn't FEEL like the other Burnout games, and it is the power of the Boost.

When I hit Boost I used to feel a WOOSH! the power would force me back in my seat, and make my cheeks wobble, through my speakers I heard a sonic boom, and my car would launch itself forward like a wild animal pouncing on its prey.

In Paradise Boosting just makes my car go a little bit faster.

I want to FEEL the BOOST with all 6 senses, so I will play Revenge more than I will play Paradise, and I will hope that another game will come out that gives me the same adrenaline rush that Burnout Generation 1 does.

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Burnout Generation 2
author: Xandu
body:
This was my reply on the Criterion Games Forums:

I don’t see Burnout Paradise as part of the Burnout Series at all. I think it is much easier to understand Burnout Paradise if you think of Burnout 1, 2, 3 and 4 (and Legends and Dominator) as Burnout Generation 1. I see Burnout Paradise as the first game in the new series of games that I choose to call Burnout Generation 2 or Next Gen if you like. Think of it as the transition from Super Mario Bros 3 to Mario 64 or GTA2 to GTA3. There was a huge change in both technology and game play between these games and lots of people didn’t like the direction the games took. I think it is pretty much the same way with Burnout Paradise.
 
Both of these “next-gen” titles have had very successful sequels. As for Paradise I’m not sure what the future will bring… I have a feeling this will be the first and last Burnout Game in “Burnout Generation 2”.

-- The Creator --
